chapter: The Lotus Leaf and the Champion
act_title: The Lotus Leaf and the Champion

quests.title: The Lotus Leaf and the Champion

dialogue.t: Well done, my fine, hind-legged ladies and gentlemen, well done indeed! This jumping contest is. On. Fireeee!
Just a moment ago, we saw Estampe the Fearless show his awesome might!
With his impressive, epic strength, he's made a stable yet distant leap, one worthy of a favorite to take gold!
But next up, we have... The one you've all been waiting for! The unequalled! The unrivaled! The unparalleled...
Faurooooobert!
*cough*... Who will emerge as champion, and win the great honor and burden of fetching the princess?
Before the final round begins, let us take a short break and give our two contestants time to rest.
For the time being, the competition venue will be open to you all, so go forth and jump to your hearts' content! That is what the Rainsong Pond is here for, after all!
*sigh* I hope everyone'll be able to do their best today — and that they won't give up even if they fall into the pond.
The paper frog that jumps the highest will always have the furthest to fall... I hope they're ready...
(test)【三只蛙的闲置】
Well done, my fine, hind-legged ladies and gentlemen, well done indeed! This jumping contest is. On. Fireeee!
Just a moment ago, we saw Estampe the Fearless show his awesome might!
With his impressive, epic strength, he's made a stable yet distant leap, one worthy of a favorite to take gold!
But next up, we have... The one you've all been waiting for! The unequalled! The unrivaled! The unparalleled...
Faurooooobert!
*cough*... Who will emerge as champion, and win the great honor and burden of fetching the princess?
They want to fetch the princess? Wait a minute...

dialogue.sit: So the one Princess Cimest was looking for was...

dialogue.t: Th—That's gotta be a coincidence, right? But if that's the case, then this should save her a whole lot of effort!
Hehe, guess we've done our duty as the "Paladins of Breezes and Bells" too, huh?

dialogue.sit: In any case, let's check the situation out first.

dialogue.t: That's right! Let's stay focused and keep our eyes peeled!
Before the final round begins, let us take a short break and give our two contestants time to rest.
For the time being, the competition venue will be open to you all, so go forth and jump to your hearts' content! That is what the Rainsong Pond is here for, after all!
Greetings, honored guests. You don't seem like frogs.
Nonetheless... Welcome to Rainsong Pond. May your legs be limber!

dialogue.sit: Tell me about the competition...

dialogue.t: As you have seen and heard, this contest is to decide the frog who's best at jumping.
Our contestants go through the qualifiers, group matches, and elimination matches, and only those who make it through all these can reach the finals.
That, uh... sounds kinda complicated...
It's not complicated at all. Simply step into the arena and clear the challenges that lie before you!
Dear guests, if it suits your fancy, you can also try out the "Bouncing Contest" here!
This is meant to test the contestants' speed and stability when jumping. I was just about to do some practice here, then take part in the next contest.
But my skills aren't exactly up to par. I can't jump well enough on my own. Would you two be willing to assist me?

dialogue.sit: So there's no competition ongoing here?
I—I'm not the best jumper ever...

dialogue.t: Of course. The competition's already reached the finals, so the other venues are now open for practice.
Keep practicing, keep jumping, keep competing — that's the way you get better and better!
Come on, dear guests! You'll enjoy the Bouncing Contest too, I guarantee it!
Faurobert, I know how nervous you are right now, but this is the final match that every frog has been looking forward to. You...
I'm sorry, Mr. Horellou, but I... I...
Please don't blame him, sir. Give him a moment to rest.
After all, Faurobert, I'm sure you need some time to think about how you shall pleasantly surprise us all.
Estampe... You're good enough. I think—
Oh, save it, friend. You will no doubt set a new record in just a moment. Trust me.
For now, just rest. You need time.
... Alright. You're right, my friend. I need some time...
Heh. This game is pretty fun, don't you think? Paimon wants to give it a try, too.

dialogue.sit: Then be my guest.

dialogue.t: P—Paimon can pose as if she's jumping in the air too, you know? It's pretty much the same, anyway...
Hahaha, I knew you'd enjoy the Bouncing Contest!
But just now... That was just a "game." This is a long way off from a real "contest."
Only the very best of the best of us can take part in the latter!
And this contest will decide who is best suited to rescue the princess... Ah, it's just so exciting!
Oh, sorry, dear guests. My apologies... I just can't help but ramble on about Faurobert.
After all, the whole reason we've organized so many contests was to choose the paper frog with the steadiest, furthest, most awe-inspiring jump so that they could go rescue the princess!
There's still some time before the final match begins, so feel free to take a look around.
Horellou will use his booming voice to remind us when the competition is about to begin, so listen out for it, and make sure you find good seats.
Faurobert will surely win the finals. I believe in him!
Welcome, dear guests. I presume you are also here to watch the competition? Welcome, in any case, to Rainsong Pond.
You have come at the right time... but also perhaps the wrong one. The competition is coming to a close, with only the final — the result of which is already beyond doubt — left to take place.
I'm sure you have heard of Faurobert and Estampe. They are both leading exponents in the art of jumping, but in my experience, Faurobert is sure to win.
Faurobert is far better at this than all other paper frogs, and has won countless championships as a result — he is, therefore, the undisputed favorite.
He has the strongest legs, the most agile mind, the most resolute spirit... Most importantly, he constantly seeks to share his know-how with all other frogs.
Estampe is, like me, one of the paper frogs who learned by watching him... We respect, trust, and believe that he will once again achieve great success.
Before the final begins, I'd like to stay and practice a little longer to prepare for the next round of competitions.
If you do not mind, we could practice together. Perhaps you might even come up with some good ideas to help me jump all the better.

dialogue.sit: So, after choosing the paper frog who will save the princess...
Will you still organize these contests?

dialogue.t: Of course. This is not just about rescuing the princess.
Most important is the "contest" itself, and what it teaches us — self-belief, resolve, bravery...
Only a paper frog who understands and embodies such virtues will emerge as our champion.
Come then, dear guests. Hehe... Let's see if you can feel the virtue inherent in our contest.
Not bad. You're quite good at this! If you have time, I'd be willing to recommend you to the organizing committee.
The next time we hold this competition, we'll be able to measure ourselves against one another.
Still, I shan't take up more of your time until then. The final is about to begin.
Hehe, guess we'll have to see just how good this Faurobert guy is.
He'll blow your socks off for sure! Still, he did seem a bit nervous when I saw him recently...
He was constantly practicing the most basic moves... and then getting annoyed at how he was performing them.
But these are the finals. It's normal to get nervous, right?

dialogue.sit: Yeah, these are the finals.
A bit of nerves are to be expected.

dialogue.t: That's what I thought, but...
No, I still believe in him. He's not the type to give in so easily.
I've got to keep practicing myself. If you'd like, dear guests, please feel free to have a look around.
The finals are about to begin, though, so be sure you don't miss them.
Faurobert... I can only hope that you're in better shape now...
And here it is, here it comes! My fine hind-legged ladies and gentlemen, the unparalleled Faurobert steps forward to make his leap! And he—
...He jumped three lotus leaves... and fell into the water...
I—It seems we have a champion — the one who will welcome our princess is Estampeee! Congratulations to our—
No! Mr. Horellou, I protest! This is ridiculous — absurd, even! I shall not accept the title of champion in this manner.
Goodness gracious, by the morning dew... Come now, you surpassed Faurobert in front of all frogkind!
Faurobert slipped up, that's all... He's just not in good form, you know?
That will not convince me, nor any other paper frogs! Anyway, let's give Faurobert a moment to himself... Hmm, we'll continue this later — it seems we have guests.
Welcome, welcome to Rainsong Pond. What can I help you with?

dialogue.sit: What's this competition about?
We saw a frog make a really awesome leap!

dialogue.t: As you can see, it is a jumping contest.
Only the most legendary leaper may take the crown, thus earning the great burden of rescuing the princess... This is why we organize so many contests.
I imagine that you saw the frog who just made his leap... That was Faurobert, one of our contestants, and the greatest jumper in all the pond... or he used to be, anyway.
Huh, sounds pretty cool! Shame we seem to have missed it all, though...

dialogue.sit: Otherwise, I'd have taken part.
What a shame. You'd have done so well too, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Really? Paimon's never seen you jump that far before — except when you were running away from monsters...

dialogue.sit: It's the taking part that counts. You never know, we might get a prize for participating...

dialogue.t: Hey, why's the reward always the first thing on your mind?
Hahaha! In that case, you'd do well to ask our champion over here for some advice.
...My apologies, dear guests, and Mr. Horellou too, but I said it before and I'll say it again. I'm no champion!
But as surely as the lotus stems stand, according to the rules, you are the champion!
I'll be the judge of that, thank you very much! This contest is meant to pick the best of us — the most skilled of jumpers — to go save our princess. This is a matter of the honor of all frogkind!
And Faurobert is the very best of us. You know this — all of us do!

dialogue.sit: So Faurobert was really that impressive?

dialogue.t: Oh... We've heard a lot of other paper frogs talking about him. Is everything they say about him true?
That's right. Faurobert is... was, the best frog in our pond.
He could easily bound all the way across twelve lotus leaves and land on the thirteenth, and he'd land so lightly that the dew upon the leaf would not be disturbed.
He could even jump between lotus leaves amidst a flowing river and not fall into the water, no matter how fierce the current.

dialogue.sit: But we just saw him, uh...
So I'm guessing he's... not in good form right now?

dialogue.t: Yeah, he seems kinda down. He looked super sad when he was leaving just now too.
He's just having a temporary rough patch. That's the only reason he made that mistake.
Please, Mr. Horellou, for the sake of the contest, and the sake of our calling, I'd like to ask for a rematch.
If you deem it necessary, you can consult the opinion of all the other frogs. I am sure they'll concur.
Listen, Estampe, I know you're a capital fellow, sharp-minded, and upstanding to boot.
But did you not see how Faurobert was faring? He left without even attempting to make another leap...
I'll speak with him. We've trained together all this time, so I know how he feels. He'll understand.
Ah, for the love of lotus leaves and lucent dew... Alright. I'll go with you to meet Faurobert.
We'll come along too! We're, uh, really good at encouraging people!

dialogue.sit: And we're great jumpers too!

dialogue.t: Eh? Have you been secretly training behind Paimon's back or something?

dialogue.sit: I'm just good at making others jump... a long way away.

dialogue.t: Hahaha. Both humorous and polite! Thank you for your goodwill. In that case, let us go together.
With any luck, that good humor of yours might soothe his sore spirit... Pond protect us. I wonder which shall serve us better — the soft or hard approach?
*sigh* I hope everyone'll be able to do their best today — and that they won't give up even if they fall into the pond.
The paper frog that jumps the highest will always have the furthest to fall... I hope they're ready...
Poor Faurobert. We've squashed that poor froggy flat under the weight of our expectations.
*sigh* If you ask me, winning all the time does a frog no good. The tallest Lotus Head always breaks first, as they say.
He's here!
Ah, there you are. The award ceremony is over, then?
Just the opposite, in fact! Both Mr. Horellou and I are of the opinion that things are far from over.
Indeed. I hereby announce, in my capacity as referee, that you, Mr. Faurobert, have one more chance to jump.
To maintain the fairness of this competition, and to fulfill our duty to the calling, you must do a re-jump.
Dear Mr. Horellou, I, as a contestant, cite the competition rules pertaining to competitive behavior that may bring harm to oneself and one's tribe...
I forfeit my second jump attempt... I do not want to disappoint everyone again, nor bring ruin to our calling. This is the only truly responsible course of action.
Wow, what a professional answer. He even had the specific clauses handy!

dialogue.sit: He even gave it a touch of emotional appeal...

dialogue.t: Alright, looks like playing hardball isn't going to work! Oh, lucent dew and lotus leaves...

dialogue.sit: But you haven't left the venue.

dialogue.t: ...I don't understand what you mean to say, dear guest.

dialogue.sit: This is the best place from which to watch the competition unfold.
If you really wanted to give up, you wouldn't have stayed here.

dialogue.t: Huh... You're right! You can see everything that's going on in the long-distance jumping contest from here!
If he really had given up and no longer wanted to have anything to do with the contest... Why would he stay?
I don't wish to talk about this anymore. I believe I've been clear. Sorry, Estampe, and our two guests as well.
Poor Faurobert. We've squashed that poor froggy flat under the weight of our expectations.
*sigh* If you ask me, winning all the time does a frog no good. The tallest Lotus Head always breaks first, as they say.
Failure is a deep pond indeed, doubt is the choking algae, and avoidance is the shackling sludge.
Faurobert, Faurobert, Faurobert, how are you going to hop out of this one...
*pants* So... tiring...

dialogue.sit: H... Hang on a moment!
L—Listen... to us... would you...

dialogue.t: Is there anything else I can help you with, dear guests? You saw the terrible state I was in.
...I admit, I mostly knew what you were going to say the moment I saw you arriving with Estampe.
My answer is "no," and so it will always be.
Look at my ankles... They are not ankles that can carry such a heavy burden. Not ones that can save a princess.

dialogue.sit: They look like pretty sturdy ankles to me!
A finer pair of ankles I have never seen!

dialogue.t: Y—Yeah! Paimon hasn't either!
But I made a mistake... No, I have been making mistakes all along. I'm sorry, you two, but I cannot continue competing.
H—Hey, don't go! We just wanna tell you one thing, one last thing!

dialogue.sit: All frogs make mistakes.
They just need to learn from them, that's all!

dialogue.t: Good guest, you do not understand. I... I initially believed that mistakes were mere drops of dew that fall upon our heads. Nothing that could truly knock a froggy down.
But I was wrong. Perhaps they were never mere drops but rather more akin to rocks at the bottom of a pond, withered wood stuck into the waterbed, or a vent hidden within the muck.
We can overlook them, bury them, step over them, or pretend they don't exist.
But they will not rest, my friend. They will await their opportunity, for a chance to come back to bite you.
Please go, and let me go too. I am nothing but a mere Lotus Head who has had all its seeds removed.
Even a light breeze would surge through the many holes in my heart and chill me to the bone.
I cannot take up this great burden. This is the voice of my heart. I have let all frogs down — including myself.

dialogue.sit: You still have a retry, you know.

dialogue.t: Yeah, you've got another chance to prove yourself!
...I do not wish to taste the bitter pang of failure once more. My legs and my heart cannot...
Whoa! This lotus leaf is moving all of a sudden. What's going on!?
What? But it should have been fixed in place...
...No, it's moving forward. Please stand firm, dear guests. I will steer it as best I can!
(test)希望大力王能重新找回状态。
Would you look. At. That! Faurobert the Unyielding! Faurobert the Bold! He's seized the opportunity for a retry — and... *gasp*! A spectacular leap. Spectacular indeed!
This is a miracle, without precedent! He is... the only paper frog ever to leap across this precipice!
I knew you had it in you, Faurobert! I believed in you!
The lotus leaf that suddenly started moving — that was your doing, wasn't it?
It was something that Mr. Horellou and I came up with together. I apologize, dear guests, for hiding this from you.

dialogue.sit: W—Well, it was certainly exciting!
I'd do it all over again!
A bit of advance notice would be appreciated though!

dialogue.t: Alright then, Faurobert. Now that everyone has witnessed your great leap — you no longer have any reason to reject the victor's crown.
But it was a coincidence, a miracle born of circumstances! Just one... one fluke leap.
It was only with the aid of these two guests that I was able to do it at all.

dialogue.sit: I'll be honest, we were just having fun drifting alongside you.

dialogue.t: Exactly, we were just watching from the sidelines. That big jump was all you.

dialogue.sit: Still, our work wasn't in vain.

dialogue.t: Right? Hehe, it would've been a waste to stand by and watch such a brilliant... frog give up like that.
You love it so much, and you trained so hard for so long — it would've been awful if you'd just given up.

dialogue.sit: A tragedy for you and frog-kind!
Just glad that you didn't actually give up.

dialogue.t: Ah, honored guests! Truly, your hearts are purer than the first drop of morning dew.
I am sorry, my friend, to have done you such an injustice... You should have been the winner of that match.
Ah, come now! You proved that you were the best of us, did you not? Please, listen to me.
We have many competitions ahead of us, and I will gladly compete with you a hundred, a thousand times more!
But this time, we must put our best frog forward to fetch the princess.
That is our "calling," and the future of Rainsong Pond rests upon it. As such, there is no room for error — do you understand me?
I do.
Good, Faurobert, that's wonderful!
Hahaha, well this all seems to have turned out great! We have ourselves a real champion now, don't we?
Next up, our champion shall go rescue the princess, and then our "calling" will be complete!

dialogue.sit: Uh, not to interrupt or anything...
About that princess of yours...

dialogue.t: Yeah, so uh... You've said a whole bunch about this princess of yours. Fetch her this, best frog that...
Now everything's ready, do you actually know where the princess is?
Hahaha, of course. We are about to go receive and rescue her — for she lives in a tower made of vines and giant trees.
Only the bravest, boldest, most jumpiest of frogs may evade the thorns and deep mist, leaping atop the tower to deliver the princess from her cage.

dialogue.sit: Seems like a lot of pressure to be putting on someone.
To the top in one jump...

dialogue.t: I'll definitely fall down halfway...
Come now, Faurobert, don't be in such a rush to return to the pond. Why, we have yet to even lay eyes upon that tree!
Our hard work has paid off! We have located the tower — it is in the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells!
Um, Mr. Horellou, there is naught there but forest and flying squirrel. Certainly not a high tower.
Are you certain that it is our destination?
Absolutely! I personally went to inspect that place. The tower there is so high that you can barely see the top! There are none, I reckon, who might scale it, apart from us paper frogs.
That sounds really impressive...

dialogue.sit: Let me go take a look first.
Then let's meet in the kingdom.

dialogue.t: You're coming along too? That would be wonderful!
Hahaha! Looks like we've got quite the crowd for our little princess welcoming party! Not bad, not bad at all.
See? I knew that things would work out for the best.
Let us make our preparations, then set forth for the Kingdom of Breezes and Bells. As for you, dear guests, we shall see you there.
Ah, yes. Mr. Faurobert, please go to the award ceremony first, would you? It will take place at the pond.
No!
Would you look. At. That! Faurobert the Unyielding! Faurobert the Bold! He's seized the opportunity for a retry — and... *gasp*! A spectacular leap. Spectacular indeed!
This is a miracle, without precedent! He is... the only paper frog ever to leap across this precipice!
I knew you had it in you, Faurobert! I believed in you!
The lotus leaf that suddenly started moving — that was your doing, wasn't it?
It was something that Mr. Horellou and I came up with together. I apologize, dear guests, for hiding this from you.

dialogue.sit: W—Well, it was certainly exciting!
I'd do it all over again!
A bit of advance notice would be appreciated though!

dialogue.t: Alright then, Faurobert. Now that everyone has witnessed your great leap — you no longer have any reason to reject the victor's crown.
Faurobert... Just what's going on with you? *sigh*...
Wha... How!? How could this be!? How could Faurobert flub it so badly...
Failure is a deep pond indeed, doubt is the choking algae, and avoidance is the shackling sludge.
Faurobert, Faurobert, Faurobert, how are you going to hop out of this one...
Not bad. It seems Faurobert has proven himself. None can doubt the distance of that jump.
What a toadally ribbeting performance! Faurobert's jumped back on top of his game, just like before!
That's great! *sigh* I almost thought Faurobert had just given up. It would've been such a pity if he had...
Faurobert, Faurobert... You must caution yourself, do not again be bound by vines of the mind.
For a paper frog like you to fail on account of such would be simply and utterly ridiculous.

quests.description: There seems to be a grand contest taking place at Rainsong Pond…
